title: VXAce Looking For A Certain Type Battle System

posts.author: Ariel_Schnee
posts.body:
I once played a game on VX called "Eternal Eden" made by Blossomsoft.
It had a great battle system with character animations.
Does anyone know if there's currently an Ace version of that battle system?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
If I remember correctly there is an Ace version of Tankentai.
Unfortunately it was never really popular outside japan due to the fact that for a long time there was no translation and it is rather complex to configure.
You might be better trying your way with "Battle Engine Symphonie" - it is similar even if it has less features than Tankentai.
Or you might consider moving up - MV/MZ have native sideview battles and many plugins for implementing action sequences.
If you're willing to wait for a sale, MV is really cheap several times a year, see:
RPG Maker MV
